answer_1.quote: the response abstractor aims to produce more comprehensive and human-understandable explanations by summarizing the responses from each cluster.

answer_2.quote: For the generation quality of the response abstractor, we calculate the perplexity (PPL) by GPT-2 and the factual consistency by FactCC.

answer_4.quote: We recruit 100 human readers and conduct two parts of user study. In part A, we randomly select 10 samples from each of the three datasets... Readers are requested to assess the informativeness of the summaries based on the viewpoint coverage and diversity using a Likert scale from 1 to 5.
